name: 46563 · Plymouth, IN
findings: ZIP 46563 (Plymouth) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46563 (Plymouth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46563 (Plymouth) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
